Messages.Author: tetragrammaton
Messages.Body:
Hy,

minion A (blocking) attempt to strike with a White Phosporous Grenade
against vamp B (acting), that strikes with a S:CE (say, a majesty);
minion A controller then plays a rotschreck against vamp B.
Is that legal ?(to play rotschreck "against" a S:CE)
If yes:
1) does minion A take the damage if he/she was using the WPG
at close range ?
2 ) the WP Grenade is burned anyway?

thanks in advance

Emiliano, v:ekn Prince of Rome

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
tetragrammaton wrote:
>
> Hy,
>
> minion A (blocking) attempt to strike with a White Phosporous Grenade
> against vamp B (acting), that strikes with a S:CE (say, a majesty);
> minion A controller then plays a rotschreck against vamp B.
> Is that legal ?(to play rotschreck "against" a S:CE)

Yes.

> If yes:
> 1) does minion A take the damage if he/she was using the WPG
> at close range ?

No. Strike resolution doesn't occur.

> 2 ) the WP Grenade is burned anyway?

No. Strike resolution doesn't occur.
